paragraphs.text: The Tendo Peaks (TEHN-doh; Japanese: 天 戸 ; rōmaji : Tendo ; literally: "Heaven's Door") are the steep mountains in the heart of Sokenzan .

Untaidake (“cloud keeper") is the tallest mountain of the Tendo Peaks. Another mountain, the Heart of Frost , was once haunted by a yuki-onna . Ryusei , the Falling Star, guards the Tendo Peaks and the Sokenzan.
